status: design proposal, not implemented or deployed

selectionRules.screen: existing server-lobby eight-beast, three-row character selector
selectionRules.partnerUnlockRuleStatus: Selected beast's matching native variant is the stated prerequisite; no extra partner prerequisite proposed.
selectionRules.higherDifficultyCountsForLowerTier: undecided; draft assumes separate matching clears
selectionRules.selectionStorage: native beast plus variant 0..2, with an explicit mod-owned hybrid flag

designRules: Each hybrid retains its owner's matching normal-row perk and adds one perk from a different beast.
For this first proposal both component perks use the same normal row, so mirrored recipes unlock at the same global milestone.
Each recipe is available from both component beasts; appearance follows the selected beast.
Keep native family bonuses and drawbacks. Do not double family passives or silently remove penalties.
These are fixed alternatives, not cumulative additions to all earlier native perks.

pairs.reason: Body-part kills can support an aggressive fighting style while eligible Wild poses buff the party.
pairs.watch: Body-part attacks do not automatically trigger the pose. Native kill, Wild, and pose requirements remain.

pairs.reason: Melee kills prepare powered throws, while the Monkey opener and trainer rerolls help adapt the build.
pairs.watch: A utility pairing rather than an automatic proc loop. Keep the two-skull affliction; apply both perks before trainer initialization.

pairs.reason: Rhino damage reduction and durable shields complement Bear's on-hit immunity and Fury.
pairs.watch: Bear's slower movement remains. Blocked hits are not assumed to trigger taking-damage effects.

pairs.reason: Panther's special-attack bonus pairs with Ibex movement and cheaper dodges.
pairs.watch: Panther's health penalty remains; cheaper dodges do not directly raise special-attack damage.

pairs.reason: Eligible poses and body-part pickups provide separate native coin sources.
pairs.watch: This is an economy choice rather than a direct damage upgrade. Native result accounting has independent income paths.

pairs.reason: Pounces provide repositioning and trips; backstabs prepare powered throws.
pairs.watch: A trip is not automatically a backstab. The player still needs a valid backstab trigger. Keep Panther's health penalty.

pairs.reason: Mighty Bear's blunt damage and brief stuns pair with longer Rhino stuns and shield durability.
pairs.watch: Enemy immunity and attack rules still apply. Do not promise a permanent stun lock. Bear's slower movement remains.

pairs.reason: Low-health Vigor supplies mobility and stamina recovery for Monkey unarmed fighting and launching specials.
pairs.watch: The Vigor benefit is conditional. Monkey trainer rerolls must initialize correctly; this pairing adds no healing.

pairs.reason: Crowd-supplied weapons and automatic bonus-skill progression make a deliberately unpredictable run.
pairs.watch: An adaptation build rather than a precise damage synergy. Clearly describe Curious Monkey's forced training choices.

pairs.reason: Successful blocks prepare Power Throw; Reckless Rhino supplies the throwable shield.
pairs.watch: This is the pair the user reported working in the lab. Broader damage, multiplayer, and restore behavior still need their own tests.

pairs.reason: Bear's revival supports a frontline role, while Ibex extends chains and strengthens chain trips and squeezes.
pairs.watch: Chain value depends on the mode and chain layout. The two family movement factors combine to 0.96 before other effects. Revival is not infinite.

pairs.reason: Repeated hits reward staying on one target; available body-part pickups provide healing between exchanges.
pairs.watch: Healing requires pickups, not hits. Changing targets resets the repeat-hit bonus. Keep Panther's health penalty.

knownExcludedPairs.reason: Bone Collector's native pickup branch suppresses Ravenous healing.
Different triggers share one Power Throw status; not a four-times multiplier.
